candidates.change_summary: Change the return statement from `return true;` to `return false;` so a successful call returns false instead of true.
Change the final return value from true to false so every successful call now returns false.
Delete the require(_s) check so a failed external transferFrom call no longer reverts the transaction.
Change the guard to require(_tos.length > 1) so calling with an empty array now returns true instead of reverting.
Start the loop at index 1 so the first recipient never receives the transfer, and single-recipient calls make no external call at all.
Change the loop bound to i <= _tos.length so the loop reads one past the end of the array and reverts for every call.
